name: mirage
text: Doing exactly that, in the release shipping now. Days older than 35 days become one daily-numbers record each (profit, staked, wins, losses), worked out from Novig's money and cached on the phone permanently; their individual bets are then removed. The phone downloads only the last 45 days of wallet rows (the full history stays on GitHub), and the money maths is done once per new file instead of on every bet save.
